messages.content: An existing full-page DAO creation wizard needs a prefilled member-management step. Produce a compile-oriented implementation handoff, not a standalone prototype. Identify the supported design-system composition and exact contracts needed to: initialize existing member addresses, let users add/edit/remove rows, distinguish editable input from accepted/resolved addresses, report invalid and duplicate entries through the owning form, and preserve the wizard's existing form ownership and navigation. Include required provider assumptions, relevant address-resolution/checksum/network semantics, and revision-matched source or example references available in this project. Call out any tempting but incorrect nesting or state-ownership choices. Do not invent APIs; explicitly mark anything the supplied project cannot establish.

The design system has formatting issues. Address each one below, then call `check_design_system` to confirm the result is valid (fix anything it still reports and call it again until it's clean):

• 32 custom properties were declared under component-style selectors (e.g. `.prose blockquote`, `.prose img, .prose  video`, `:where(.space-y-0\.5 > :not(:last-child))`) and weren't registered as design-system tokens. If any are theme tokens, move them under :root or a [data-*] scope.
• 30 of 356 tokens couldn't be classified as color/spacing/radius/shadow/font from name or value (15 unique): `--ease-out`, `--ease-in-out`, `--animate-spin`, `--animate-ping`, `--animate-pulse`, `--default-transition-duration`, `--default-transition-timing-function`, `--animate-shake`, `--tw-translate-x`, `--tw-translate-y`, +5 more. Add a `/* @kind color|spacing|radius|shadow|font */` comment after each (`/* @kind other */` marks a token as intentionally uncategorized), or rename to include the kind.

Notes (no action needed):

messages.content:
Both reported issues live entirely in `_ds_bundle.css` — the compiled Tailwind output synced from the repo, which is read-only here (`styles.css` only `@import`s it). Nothing writable in this project declares them:

- The 32 custom properties under component selectors are Tailwind internals (`--tw-translate-x`, `--tw-content`, `.prose` element rules) emitted by the compiler, not theme tokens. They can't be moved to `:root` without breaking the utilities that read them per-element.
- The 30 unclassified tokens (`--ease-*`, `--animate-*`, `--default-transition-*`, `--tw-*`) are already classified as `other` in `_adherence.oxlintrc.json`; annotating them would mean editing the generated bundle, which the next sync would overwrite.

So `check_design_system` will keep reporting these. The fix belongs upstream: either have the `/design-sync` run emit `/* @kind other */` annotations (or the token-kind map) for the Tailwind-internal properties and exclude non-token custom properties from the token scan. Raise it with the `/design-sync` agent on the next run — want me to write that up as a short note in the project for that handoff?
